errors.text_span: 来自中国及其他国家的全新患者人数与每日确诊病例数量之间的关系
errors.evidence: The chart shows global daily new COVID-19 cases and related news reports, not specifically patients from China and other countries.

errors.text_span: 水平轴显示日期，从2022年7月15日到2022年8月26日
errors.evidence: The x-axis covers the period from July 1, 2022, to August 26, 2022, not July 15, 2022, to August 26, 2022.
The left y-axis interval is 200,000, not 100,000.

errors.text_span: 该图表包含多个堆叠的柱状图
errors.evidence: The chart contains individual bars, not stacked bars.
The description does not mention the right y-axis label (相关新闻媒体每日报道数量).
The description does not mention the right y-axis range (0–6,000, step size 1,000).
The description does not mention the blue line representing COVID-19-related news report counts.
The description does not mention the synchronization trend between the two data series.
The description does not mention the differences in peak periods, such as the lag effect between case peaks and news report increases.

errors.text_span: 垂直轴的刻度线是线性的，以整数间隔，间隔为100000人
errors.evidence: Awkward phrasing and incorrect interval value reduce clarity.
